|personas=* [[Han Solo (persona)|Han]]
|lore=Corellian. Graduated with honors from the Imperial Academy. Dishonorably discharged. Wanders the galaxy building a reputation as a '''gambler''' and hot-shot pilot.
|game_text=Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots (4 if ''Falcon''). While armed with a blaster, Han’s defense value and weapon destiny draws are +2. Force retrieval with Or Be Destroyed is immune to Secret Plans. While Or Be Destroyed on table, immune to attrition < Han’s power.
|printings={{Card versions/Han}}
|notes=The 2006 slip puts the armed defense and weapon-destiny bonuses before the Or Be Destroyed clauses. The [[Han (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution) (Original)|original-edition slip]] survives in the consolidated PDF made in February 2003. The sheet gives 20 September 2002 as the set’s tournament-legality date, and the complete set was available by 21 September. The [[Han (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution) (Remastered 2006)|2006 publication]] gives its text as of 4 December 2006.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153955/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards3.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 2, slip 11. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
